choose_saved_fields: Choose columns for manual and automatic saving:
save_format_note: The basic NanoVNA CSV format is preserved; new columns are appended.
model_time_warning: Fitting multiple models may take a long time and use the CPU heavily. Acquisition will be paused.
template_vars: Template variables: {i}, {X}, {date}, {mode}. In Python mode the code may provide its own filename using |name=...
python_instruction: Commands must be sent with print(..., flush=True). nanoOK_<index>|name=<name> saves a measurement. nanoDataMem sets Data → Mem. Range: nanoRangeStart:10MHz and nanoRangeStop:100MHz. One-shot save: nanoCSV-s11-s21-zs11-memory, nanoS1P-s11 or nanoS2P-s11-s21. Fields: s11, s21, s11ri, s21ri, zs11, vswr, memory, markers, tdr, all. Do not use hyphens in names; hyphens separate command elements.
generate_report_after: Generate a PDF report when finished
tdr_auto_zoom: Automatically zoom to the useful beginning of the trace
tdr_settings_explanation: Z0 is the VNA reference impedance and is normally 50 Ω. VF does not alter the measurement; it only converts propagation delay into metres. Select the time axis when VF is unknown. Distance resolution is determined mainly by the measurement bandwidth.
tdr_current_resolution: Estimated resolution for the current bandwidth: {value} m
tdr_settings_invalid: Check VF, Z0 and the distance range.
tdr_info_no_data: Enable S11 and TDR to calculate the time-domain response.
tdr_info: Resolution ≈ {resolution}; alias-free range ≈ {range}; BW={bandwidth}. Objects shorter than the resolution cannot be separated.
deadline_reached: The configured series end time has been reached.
series_finish_rule: The series ends when the requested number of measurements is saved or when the time limit expires, whichever occurs first.
python_default_comment_1: # The code runs as a separate Python process.
auto_invalid_settings: Check the measurement count, interval, end time and output folder.
python_finished_early: The control code ended before all requested indices were saved.
report_error: Could not generate the series report
series_completed: The automatic measurement series has finished.
series_stopped_status: The automatic measurement series was stopped.
no_plugins: No .py files in the plugins folder
s2p_assumption: .s2p assumes S12=S21 and S22=S11 because NanoVNA provides S11 and S21.
invalid_range_points: Enter a valid frequency range and number of points.
choose_one_file_format: Select at least one file format.
calibration_saved_current_range: OSLT calibration was saved for the current frequency range.
click_ok_to_calibrate: Click OK to take the calibration measurement.
no_data_to_save: There is no measurement data to save.
no_report_data: There is no data available for the report.
cal_open_prompt: Connect the OPEN standard (open circuit) to port 1.
cal_short_prompt: Connect the SHORT standard (short circuit) to port 1.
cal_load_prompt: Connect the 50 Ω LOAD standard to port 1.
cal_thru_prompt: Connect port 1 to port 2 using the THRU standard.
calibration_not_found_log: No calibration was found for exactly this frequency range and number of points.
